text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or got injured during 
training, so I brought her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. For causing you so much 
trouble..."
choice_data_list: Glad it was only a minor injury.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a blessing in disguise... So 
let's head back and resume training—
choice_data_list: No, you need to rest properly...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I get the feeling we don't 
have much leeway to spare..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not good at conflict. Stepping 
forward isn't my strong suit, either..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And yet, if I stop in my tracks, the gap 
between me and everyone else—will only 
widen.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So please— allow me to continue my 
training...!"
choice_data_list:
No, let's make sure to get some proper 
rest here!
No, we should rest properly here!

Let's try some light exercise and see how 
it goes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So please— allow me to continue my 
training...!"
choice_data_list:
No, let's make sure to get some proper 
rest here!
No, we should rest properly here!

Let's try some light exercise and see how 
it goes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: B-But...
choice_data_list:
As long as you have the drive to win, 
you'll definitely catch up.

As long as you have the drive to win, 
you'll definitely catch up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It's true that I'm not 
very good at pushing myself forward on my 
own...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Still, when it comes to the desire to win 
a race... I don't think I'll lose to 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is not something that will simply 
fade away after a little rest—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest, 
strengthen my resolve, and make up for 
lost time—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Now then, let us head 
back to the track.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I'm good. Looks like I can keep 
going. Alright, one more lap...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Even after making such an 
unreasonable request, it ended up like 
this... I am truly, terribly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her injury worsening, Curren 
Bouquetd'or spent some time resting 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's... no pain, it seems. Um, 
can I keep going like this—
choice_data_list:
If it's within reason and you don't push 
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes... We shall proceed with caution—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Bouquetd'or continued to 
recover smoothly.
